event_var.var_meaning: overall survival event status (inferred coding: '1' = death/event, '0' = censored/alive)

notes: Source/provenance: GEO series GSE216037 sample metadata (fields under Sample_characteristics_ch1; e.g., GSM6656519) and study Methods which state 'Overall survival of patients was assessed using Kaplan–Meier analysis.'

Unit 'month' taken directly from the time variable name 'overall survival(month)'; the time origin (e.g., from diagnosis, surgery, or sample collection) is not specified in the paper or metadata and is therefore unknown.

The coding of 'survival state' (0 vs 1) is not explicitly defined in the metadata or manuscript; the mapping '1' = death and '0' = censored/alive is inferred from the pattern of values (samples with long follow-up commonly have '0', short follow-up often have '1') and the use of Kaplan–Meier, but this inference is not explicitly stated by the authors.
Observed time values in the metadata include integer and decimal month values (e.g., '9.5'), consistent with the var_unit 'month'.
No other survival endpoints (e.g., progression-free survival, disease-free survival) were identified in the provided metadata or paper text.
